method: Local regex and high-entropy-assignment scan; git cat-file --batch-all-objects includes reachable, reflog and unreachable blobs. Binary/large objects counted but not semantically inspected. No network validation.
review: Credential URL matches use example hosts/templates; remaining assignment matches are synthetic test/benchmark values. No confirmed active credentials were identified. This is not a guarantee of absence.

ignoredLocalEnvironment.finding: Nonempty credential-bearing URL; not copied, staged, committed or remotely tested. Owner should verify and rotate if previously shared.

publicCandidate.historyPolicy: Fresh git init; verify exactly one parentless root commit, no remotes, object alternates or old server paths across all reachable trees.

legalReview: Root package license remains UNLICENSED; no repository LICENSE/NOTICE chosen.
Icon and UI screenshot provenance/redistribution rights require owner review.
Dependency license metadata inventory covers 669 installed packages; metadata is not a distribution license review.
limitations: Regex cannot detect all secret formats or establish validity.
Binary assets were not OCR scanned or exhaustively reviewed for personal content.
No Apple keychain or external production system inspection.
